pairs.english: After work the next day,

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rào dào kōng liào péng ,
pairs.english: Tavi went round to the empty storage shed,
but did not go straight in.
Outside the door he undid his cuffs
and held his hands in the light.

pairs.target: zuótiān hé sè lā suàn dào zuìhòu ,
pairs.english: By the end of yesterday's reckoning with Sela,
they were still three copper coins short.

pairs.target: jīntiān lǐngdào de gōngqián bǔ bùmǎn nàge quēkǒu ,
pairs.english: Today's wages could not fill that gap,
pairs.hanzi: 今天领到的工钱补不满那个缺口，

pairs.target: yīnwèi míngtiān de fàn yě yào cóng lǐmiàn chū .
pairs.english: because tomorrow's food had to come out of them too.
pairs.hanzi: 因为明天的饭也要从里面出。

pairs.target: nà zhāngjiā yòng cǎo zhàng liúzài zào biān ,
pairs.english: The rough household account stayed beside the stove;
pairs.hanzi: 那张家用草账留在灶边，

pairs.target: tā dàilái de shì lìng yìzhāng zhǐ ,
pairs.english: he had brought a different sheet,
the one Rutzen had written.

pairs.target: mén lǐ xiǎngqǐ mùtou luòdì de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: Inside, wood clattered to the floor.
pairs.hanzi: 门里响起木头落地的声音。

pairs.target: " lái le jiù bāng wǒ fú yíxià . "
pairs.english: “Since you're here, help me hold this,”
Nerai said.

pairs.target: tā zhèng bǎ yìzhāng xiǎozhuō bānlí qiángjiǎo .
pairs.english: She was moving a small table away from the corner.
pairs.hanzi: 她正把一张小桌搬离墙角。

pairs.english: Rain leaked onto its old spot,
leaving a semicircle of water stains on the tabletop.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fúzhù kào mén de yìbiān ,
pairs.english: Tavi steadied the side nearest the door;

pairs.target: liǎng rén tái dào gān chù .
pairs.english: together they lifted it to a dry place.
After he let go,

pairs.target: zhǐ fù shàng liúxià mù biān yāchū de qiǎn hén ,
pairs.english: faint impressions from the wooden edge remained on his fingertips.
pairs.hanzi: 指腹上留下木边压出的浅痕，

pairs.english: He could distinguish the splintered spots
from those worn smooth.
That was different from yesterday morning.

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zhī shuō shǒu hǎo le ,
pairs.english: He didn't simply say his hands were better;

pairs.target: érshì bǎ zhèdiǎn qūbié gàosù le nài lěi .
pairs.english: he told Nerai about that particular difference.
pairs.hanzi: 而是把这点区别告诉了奈蕾。

pairs.english: She had him sit,
took out the two beans,
and placed them in his palm.
Tavi closed his eyes,
distinguished the large from the small,
then, as she asked,
held a copper coin upright between his fingers.
The coin did not slip.
“Today we'll keep it brief,”
she said.
“Tell me if anything feels wrong.”
There was no white board on the table.

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎi chū liǎngzhī jiù tiějiá ,
pairs.english: Nerai set out two old iron clips,
one gripping a narrow paper strip,

pairs.target: lìngyìzhī jiá zhe zhé chéng jǐcéng de bù .
pairs.english: the other holding cloth folded into several layers.
pairs.hanzi: 另一只夹着折成几层的布。

pairs.target: zhǐtiáo hé bù dōu chuí dào zhuōmiànshàng ,
pairs.english: Both paper and cloth hung down to the tabletop,
pairs.hanzi: 纸条和布都垂到桌面上，

pairs.english: so even if they fell,
they wouldn't go far.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng yīdài lǐ mō chū nà zhī wāi jiǎo jiāzi ,
pairs.english: Tavi took the bent-legged clip from his pocket
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从衣袋里摸出那只歪脚夹子，

pairs.english: and set it alongside.
“We won't use that today.”
“I know,”
he said.
“With it here,
I'll remember.”

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn le tā yìyǎn ,
pairs.english: Nerai glanced at him
and didn't take it away.

pairs.target: tā xiān ràng tā kàn liǎngzhǐ hǎo jiāzi .
pairs.english: First she showed him the two undamaged clips.
pairs.hanzi: 她先让他看两只好夹子。

pairs.english: The paper was held tightly,
the cloth more loosely;

pairs.target: qīngqīng yì chě biàn néng chōudòng .
pairs.english: a gentle tug could move it.
There would be no tugging today.
She demonstrated just once,
then put the cloth back.

pairs.target: " nǐ búyòng děng wǒ qiāo zhuō . "
pairs.english: “You don't need to wait for me to tap the table.”
Tavi looked up.
“As soon as the paper starts to slide,
let go.
Don't wait for it to fall.
If you can't watch everything,
watch the paper first.”
“What about the other one?”
“I'll watch it for you.

pairs.target: xiān xuéhuì zuò wán yíjiàn shì . "
pairs.english: Learn to finish one thing first.”

pairs.target: tā bǎ shǒuzhǐ tiē shàng liǎngzhī jiāzi de jīnshǔ bèimiàn .
pairs.english: He set his fingers against the metal backs of both clips.
pairs.hanzi: 他把手指贴上两只夹子的金属背面。

pairs.english: The iron felt a little cool.

pairs.target: tā děng zhe nàzhǒng shúxī de sōngdòng ,
pairs.english: He waited for that familiar yielding,
pairs.hanzi: 他等着那种熟悉的松动，

pairs.english: but the longer he waited,

pairs.target: yuè juéde zhǐjiān zhǐshì liǎngkuài pǔtōng de tiě .
pairs.english: the more he felt only two ordinary pieces of iron under his fingertips.
pairs.hanzi: 越觉得指尖只是两块普通的铁。

pairs.english: The paper didn't move.

pairs.target: tā kàn le nài lěi yìyǎn .
pairs.english: He glanced at Nerai.
She didn't hurry him.
He took his hands away
and wiped the sweat from his palms.

pairs.target: " wǒ pà yòu tíng wǎn le . "
pairs.english: “I'm afraid I'll stop too late again.”
“Mm.”

pairs.target: " pà zhe jiù zuò bù chūlái . "
pairs.english: “Being afraid means I can't do it.”

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ shuǐbēi wǎng tā zhèbiān nuó .
pairs.english: Nerai moved the cup of water towards him.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把水杯往他这边挪。

pairs.english: A small piece of the rim was missing.
She turned it
so the chip faced her.
“One year,

pairs.target: tìrén jiǎnchá yízuò diàoqiáo de kòujiàn . "
pairs.english: I inspected the fasteners on a suspension bridge for someone.”
pairs.hanzi: 替人检查一座吊桥的扣件。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái shēnxiàng bēizi de shǒu tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: Tavi's hand stopped on its way to the cup.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来伸向杯子的手停住了。

pairs.english: “Outside the mountains?”
“In the mountains.
A small bridge for carrying salt,
with a gully underneath.
I knew that kind of iron.
I inspected one fastener
and thought the rest were much the same.
There was one at the end
I didn't open up to inspect.”
She picked up the bent clip

pairs.target: yòng zhǐjiǎ diǎn le diǎn nèicè .
pairs.english: and tapped its inside with a fingernail.
“Polished outside,
rusted inside.
The next day they pulled an empty cart across to test the bridge.
That fastener split,
and the cart tilted at the bridge entrance.
No one fell,
but the salt carts couldn't cross;

pairs.target: jǐjiā rén de gōng dōu tíng le . "
pairs.english: several families' work came to a halt.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng zhe tā shuō hòulái zěnyàng bǔ hǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi waited for her to explain how they repaired it afterwards.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等着她说后来怎样补好。

pairs.target: tā què xiān bǎ jiāzi fàngxià .
pairs.english: Instead she put the clip down first.

pairs.target: " wǒ zài jìlù shàng xiě de shì ' yǐ chá '. "
pairs.english: “What I'd written in the record was 'inspected.'”
A cart passed outside the shed,
its wheels crunching over loose stones,
the noise lasting a long time.
Nerai waited for the sound to pass
before continuing.
“I had to go back and tell them
that one hadn't actually been inspected.
The iron hadn't deceived me.

pairs.target: shì wǒ xiǎng shěng nà yìdiǎn gōngfū . "
pairs.english: I'd wanted to save that little bit of effort.”
“They still let you inspect things?”
“Later, yes.
For the first few times,
someone crouched beside me
watching me take them apart one by one.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu wàng zhe nà zhī jiāzi .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down at the clip.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头望着那只夹子。

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu shuō fàncuò shì hǎoshì ,
pairs.english: Nerai hadn't said making mistakes was good,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有说犯错是好事，

pairs.target: yě méiyǒu shuō tā zhèhuí búsuànshénme .
pairs.english: or that his own failure was nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 也没有说他这回不算什么。

pairs.target: tā fǎnér néng bǎ nà kǒu yìzhí dǔ zài xiōngkǒu de qì hūchūlái le .
pairs.english: Yet he could finally breathe out the breath that had been trapped in his chest.
pairs.hanzi: 他反而能把那口一直堵在胸口的气呼出来了。

pairs.english: After drinking,
he positioned his hands again.

pairs.target: zhècì tā méiyǒu dīng zhe zhǐtiáo xiàmiàn de kōng chù ,
pairs.english: This time he didn't stare at the space below the paper strip,
pairs.hanzi: 这次他没有盯着纸条下面的空处，

pairs.target: érshì kàn zhǐ tiēzhe jiá kǒu de nà yìxiǎo duàn .
pairs.english: but watched the small section pressed against the clip's jaws.
pairs.hanzi: 而是看纸贴着夹口的那一小段。

pairs.english: There was an old crease there,

pairs.target: zhéhén shàng yán gāngcái hái cáng zài tiěpiàn hòumiàn .
pairs.english: its upper edge until now hidden behind the metal.
pairs.hanzi: 折痕上沿刚才还藏在铁片后面。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjué zuǒshǒu xià de jiāzi jiànjiàn sōng le .
pairs.english: He felt the clip beneath his left hand gradually loosen.
pairs.hanzi: 他感觉左手下的夹子渐渐松了。

pairs.english: A sliver of white appeared.
He let go.

pairs.target: zhǐtiáo yòu wǎng xià nuó le yìdiǎn ,
pairs.english: The paper slipped a little farther down,
then stopped,
without falling onto the table.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de shǒu xuán zài bànkōng ,
pairs.english: Tavi's hands hovered in midair.
He almost reached back to catch it,
then remembered he needn't catch it today
and slowly lowered his hands to his knees.

pairs.target: nài lěi qīngqīng pèng le pèng lìngyìbiān de bù .
pairs.english: Nerai gently touched the cloth on the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾轻轻碰了碰另一边的布。

pairs.english: “It tightened just now;
now it's loosened again.”
“That's enough?”
“For this attempt, yes.
Check your hands first.”

pairs.target: tā bǎ tóngqián cóng zhuōshàng niē qǐlái ,
pairs.english: He picked the coin up from the table
pairs.hanzi: 他把铜钱从桌上捏起来，

pairs.english: and felt its edge.
The sensation was still there.

pairs.target: nài lěi ràng tā xiē le yíhuìer ,
pairs.english: Nerai had him rest a while

pairs.target: cái bǎ zhǐtiáo fàng huí yuánwèi .
pairs.english: before putting the paper back in its original position.
The second time the paper didn't move.
He let go all the same.
The third time it slid a little,
less than the first time,
and he didn't try to add more.

pairs.target: nài lěi jiāng liǎngzhī jiāzi fēnbié zhuāngjìn xiǎo bùdài ,
pairs.english: Nerai put the two clips into separate little cloth bags
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾将两只夹子分别装进小布袋，

pairs.target: ràng tā bǎ gāngcái de sānhuí huà zài zhǐ shàng .
pairs.english: and had him draw the three attempts on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 让他把刚才的三回画在纸上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài dìèrgè quānlǐ liú le kōng ,
pairs.english: Tavi left the second circle blank,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在第二个圈里留了空，

pairs.english: thought a moment,

pairs.target: yòu tiān le yídào duǎn héng ,
pairs.english: then added a short stroke

pairs.target: miǎnde biérén yǐwéi tā wàng le jì .
pairs.english: so nobody would think he'd forgotten to record it.
pairs.hanzi: 免得别人以为他忘了记。

pairs.english: “This means no movement,”
he explained.
She handed him the pen

pairs.target: ràng tā zhàozhe xiěxià liǎnggè zì .
pairs.english: and had him copy the two characters.
While clearing the table,

pairs.target: tā wèn néng bunéng bǎ jiāzi dàigěi lǔ cén kàn .
pairs.english: he asked whether he could take the clips to show Rutzen.
pairs.hanzi: 他问能不能把夹子带给鲁岑看。

pairs.english: “You can.
Let him test them himself;

pairs.target: bié xiān gàosù tā nǎ zhī gāi jǐn . "
pairs.english: don't tell him beforehand which should be tight.”
Tavi tied the bags shut

pairs.target: jiāng wāi jiāzi lìngwài bāo qǐlái .
pairs.english: and wrapped the bent clip separately.
He took all three.

pairs.target: yǒu yìzhī bú yònglái zhèngmíng jīntiān zuòdéhǎo ,
pairs.english: One wasn't there to prove he'd done well today,
pairs.hanzi: 有一只不用来证明今天做得好，

pairs.target: dàn tā yě méiyǒu bèi rēngdiào .
pairs.english: but it wasn't thrown away either.
